from app.api import handlers


def test_user_initials_ok():
    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "1"}) == (200, {"initials": "AL"})


def test_user_initials_ok_last_word():
    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "2"}) == (200, {"initials": "LT"})


def test_user_initials_collapses_whitespace(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        handlers.users,
        "get_user",
        lambda user_id: {"id": user_id, "name": "  Grace   Brewster   Hopper  "},
    )
    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "3"}) == (200, {"initials": "GH"})


def test_user_initials_single_word(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(
        handlers.users,
        "get_user",
        lambda user_id: {"id": user_id, "name": "Prince"},
    )
    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "3"}) == (200, {"initials": "P"})

    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})

    assert handlers.handle_user_initials({"id": "abc"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
